seo_posts.excerpt: Complete clinical guide to CBC blood test in India. Understand Hemoglobin, Platelets, TLC/DLC count, fasting requirements, and turnaround time.
seo_posts.seoTitle: CBC Test Normal Range & Fasting Guide India | Complete Blood Count
seo_posts.metaDescription: Everything about Complete Blood Count (CBC) test in India: Normal values of Hb, TLC, Platelets, whether fasting is required, and understanding report results.

openGraph.ogTitle: CBC Test Normal Range & Fasting Guide India | IndianLalaJi LIMS
openGraph.ogDescription: Complete clinical guide to CBC test in India: Normal ranges, fasting rules, and turnaround time.

seo_posts.content:
What is a Complete Blood Count (CBC) Test?

A Complete Blood Count (CBC) is one of the most frequently ordered diagnostic blood investigations across hospitals and standalone pathology laboratories in India. It evaluates the overall health of your circulatory system and screens for a wide range of medical conditions, including anemia, viral or bacterial infections, inflammation, and leukemia.

Core Parameters Measured in a Standard Indian CBC

  • Hemoglobin (Hb): Measures the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells. Normal range for adult males: 13.0 to 17.0 g/dL; females: 12.0 to 15.5 g/dL.
  • Total Leukocyte Count (TLC): Total white blood cells fighting infections. Normal: 4,000 to 11,000 /cu.mm. High TLC often indicates bacterial infection.
  • Platelet Count: Essential cells preventing bleeding and facilitating clotting. Normal range: 1.50 Lakh to 4.50 Lakh /cu.mm. Critically evaluated during Dengue seasons across Indian states.
  • Packed Cell Volume (PCV / Hematocrit): The percentage of whole blood composed of RBCs. Normal: 36% to 50%.
  • Differential Leukocyte Count (DLC): Breakdown of Neutrophils (40-75%), Lymphocytes (20-45%), Monocytes (2-10%), Eosinophils (1-6%), and Basophils (0-1%).

Is Fasting Required for a CBC Test?

No fasting is required for a standalone CBC test. You can give your blood sample at any time of the day after taking your usual meals. However, if your doctor has also prescribed a Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS) or Lipid Profile alongside your CBC, a strict 10 to 12 hour overnight water-only fast is mandatory.

Sample Type & Turnaround Time (TAT)

CBC requires 2 ml of venous blood collected in a lavender top tube containing EDTA anticoagulant. In automated 5-part or 6-part hematology analyzers, test results are typically processed within 15 to 30 minutes, and the digital verified report is delivered on WhatsApp within 2 to 4 hours.
seo_posts.author: Dr. Rohit Sharma (MD Pathologist)

seo_posts.excerpt: Detailed guide to Lipid Profile blood test in India. Fasting instructions, understanding LDL, HDL, Triglycerides, and cardiac risk markers.

seo_posts.metaDescription: Understand Lipid Profile test: HDL, LDL, Triglycerides normal ranges, 12-hour fasting requirement, and how Indian diets impact cholesterol levels.

openGraph.ogTitle: Lipid Profile Test Normal Range & Fasting India | IndianLalaJi LIMS
openGraph.ogDescription: Everything about cholesterol testing: HDL, LDL, Triglycerides normal values and fasting rules.

seo_posts.content:
Why is a Lipid Profile Essential for Indian Adults?

Cardiovascular disease (CVD) has emerged as a leading health concern across urban and semi-urban India. Indians have a documented predisposition to dyslipidemia, characterized by low HDL ("good" cholesterol) and elevated Triglycerides. A comprehensive Lipid Profile measures total circulating lipids to gauge atherosclerotic cardiovascular risk.

Key Parameters in a Complete Lipid Panel

  • Total Cholesterol: Desirable level is below 200 mg/dL. Levels between 200-239 mg/dL are borderline high.
  • HDL Cholesterol (Good): Protects blood vessels from plaque accumulation. Desirable: Above 40 mg/dL for men, above 50 mg/dL for women.
  • LDL Cholesterol (Bad): Directly contributes to arterial clogging. Optimal: Below 100 mg/dL.
  • Triglycerides: Form of fat synthesized from excess calories, carbs, and fried foods. Normal: Below 150 mg/dL. High values (>200 mg/dL) require dietary intervention.
  • VLDL & Total/HDL Ratio: Additional risk indices calculated to evaluate atherogenic propensity.

Strict Fasting Protocol for Lipid Profile

Unlike CBC, a 10 to 12 hour complete fast is strictly mandatory for accurate triglyceride calculation. You may drink plain water, but tea, coffee, milk, or midnight snacks will artificially spike triglyceride measurements, leading to inaccurate medical evaluations.

seo_posts.metaDescription: Learn about Thyroid TSH test in India: Normal ranges (0.4 - 4.5 uIU/mL), signs of thyroid imbalance, morning testing tips, and medication timing.

openGraph.ogTitle: Thyroid TSH Test Normal Range & Symptoms India | IndianLalaJi LIMS
openGraph.ogDescription: Guide to Thyroid testing in India: TSH normal values, symptoms of imbalance, and testing guidelines.

seo_posts.content:
Understanding Thyroid Function in the Body

The butterfly-shaped thyroid gland located at the base of the neck secretes hormones that regulate body metabolism, body temperature, cardiac rhythm, and energy expenditure. An estimated 42 million people in India suffer from thyroid disorders, with women being 3 to 5 times more vulnerable than men.

Thyroid Hormones Explained

  • TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone): Produced by the pituitary gland. Normal range: 0.40 to 4.50 uIU/mL. Elevated TSH indicates that the thyroid is underactive (Hypothyroidism).
  • Total T3 (Triiodothyronine): Normal: 0.80 to 2.00 ng/mL.
  • Total T4 (Thyroxine): Normal: 5.10 to 14.10 ug/dL.

When Should You Take the Thyroid Test?

TSH hormone follows a diurnal rhythm, peaking in early morning hours. It is strongly recommended to give the blood sample between 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM. If you are taking thyroid medicine (such as Thyronorm / Eltroxin), consult your clinician: typically, the morning blood sample is collected before taking the daily pill.

seo_posts.content:
What is NABL Accreditation?

National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) is an autonomous constituent board of the Quality Council of India (QCI). In clinical diagnostics, NABL grants accreditation under standard ISO 15189: Medical laboratories — Requirements for quality and competence.

Key Benefits of NABL Certified Laboratory Results

seoPosts.content:
What is a Complete Blood Count (CBC) Test?

A Complete Blood Count (CBC) is one of the most frequently ordered diagnostic blood investigations across hospitals and standalone pathology laboratories in India. It evaluates the overall health of your circulatory system and screens for a wide range of medical conditions, including anemia, viral or bacterial infections, inflammation, and leukemia.

Core Parameters Measured in a Standard Indian CBC

  • Hemoglobin (Hb): Measures the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells. Normal range for adult males: 13.0 to 17.0 g/dL; females: 12.0 to 15.5 g/dL.
  • Total Leukocyte Count (TLC): Total white blood cells fighting infections. Normal: 4,000 to 11,000 /cu.mm. High TLC often indicates bacterial infection.
  • Platelet Count: Essential cells preventing bleeding and facilitating clotting. Normal range: 1.50 Lakh to 4.50 Lakh /cu.mm. Critically evaluated during Dengue seasons across Indian states.
  • Packed Cell Volume (PCV / Hematocrit): The percentage of whole blood composed of RBCs. Normal: 36% to 50%.
  • Differential Leukocyte Count (DLC): Breakdown of Neutrophils (40-75%), Lymphocytes (20-45%), Monocytes (2-10%), Eosinophils (1-6%), and Basophils (0-1%).

Is Fasting Required for a CBC Test?

No fasting is required for a standalone CBC test. You can give your blood sample at any time of the day after taking your usual meals. However, if your doctor has also prescribed a Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS) or Lipid Profile alongside your CBC, a strict 10 to 12 hour overnight water-only fast is mandatory.

Sample Type & Turnaround Time (TAT)

CBC requires 2 ml of venous blood collected in a lavender top tube containing EDTA anticoagulant. In automated 5-part or 6-part hematology analyzers, test results are typically processed within 15 to 30 minutes, and the digital verified report is delivered on WhatsApp within 2 to 4 hours.

seoPosts.content:
Why is a Lipid Profile Essential for Indian Adults?

Cardiovascular disease (CVD) has emerged as a leading health concern across urban and semi-urban India. Indians have a documented predisposition to dyslipidemia, characterized by low HDL ("good" cholesterol) and elevated Triglycerides. A comprehensive Lipid Profile measures total circulating lipids to gauge atherosclerotic cardiovascular risk.

Key Parameters in a Complete Lipid Panel

  • Total Cholesterol: Desirable level is below 200 mg/dL. Levels between 200-239 mg/dL are borderline high.
  • HDL Cholesterol (Good): Protects blood vessels from plaque accumulation. Desirable: Above 40 mg/dL for men, above 50 mg/dL for women.
  • LDL Cholesterol (Bad): Directly contributes to arterial clogging. Optimal: Below 100 mg/dL.
  • Triglycerides: Form of fat synthesized from excess calories, carbs, and fried foods. Normal: Below 150 mg/dL. High values (>200 mg/dL) require dietary intervention.
  • VLDL & Total/HDL Ratio: Additional risk indices calculated to evaluate atherogenic propensity.

Strict Fasting Protocol for Lipid Profile

Unlike CBC, a 10 to 12 hour complete fast is strictly mandatory for accurate triglyceride calculation. You may drink plain water, but tea, coffee, milk, or midnight snacks will artificially spike triglyceride measurements, leading to inaccurate medical evaluations.

seoPosts.content:
Understanding Thyroid Function in the Body

The butterfly-shaped thyroid gland located at the base of the neck secretes hormones that regulate body metabolism, body temperature, cardiac rhythm, and energy expenditure. An estimated 42 million people in India suffer from thyroid disorders, with women being 3 to 5 times more vulnerable than men.

Thyroid Hormones Explained

  • TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone): Produced by the pituitary gland. Normal range: 0.40 to 4.50 uIU/mL. Elevated TSH indicates that the thyroid is underactive (Hypothyroidism).
  • Total T3 (Triiodothyronine): Normal: 0.80 to 2.00 ng/mL.
  • Total T4 (Thyroxine): Normal: 5.10 to 14.10 ug/dL.

When Should You Take the Thyroid Test?

TSH hormone follows a diurnal rhythm, peaking in early morning hours. It is strongly recommended to give the blood sample between 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM. If you are taking thyroid medicine (such as Thyronorm / Eltroxin), consult your clinician: typically, the morning blood sample is collected before taking the daily pill.
